pass_a_gloss: Do not ignore teaching, since many are led by evil into death; those killed innocently must not be bought with your blood; give money or helpful speech when asked; claiming ignorance of someone makes you liable for lies and murder; the Creator of breath knows what each receives by character: good to good, evil to evil; reward is not by amount—present pains are nothing compared to future glory; if seeking return by measure, allocate according to ability, like spiritual gifts given by faith measure; the Scripture feeder eats honey; the one removing words from prophetic and apostolic sources, in action and instruction, chews wax; honey eating is for all desirers, wax eating for the pure; or honey means allegory, wax means literal inquiry to hold hidden and deep thought, since wax contains honey; throat is the soul’s feeding power sending food to stomach; if you master both intellectual and historical matters, they will feel to you as wisdom’s own wise teachings; finding the Scripture’s spiritual mind brings a good end, as 'Precious in the Lord’s sight is the death of His holy ones'; do not drop future hope; do not choose the devil over God’s righteousness held by the just; do not let deadly foolish talk fill your heart, which is the gut; do not hand God over for pleasure; He is the just one’s pasture. He will not abandon you. God withdraws his anger from the fallen, pitying them; yet he burns against those who gloat over an enemy’s ruin, for such joy mirrors the devil’s wish to block salvation and truth for all. The Lord bids prayer for foes—meaning all humanity—in the Gospels. The Spirit’s sword, God’s word, is not carnal but invisible. Those who fall into it while erring suffer shattered bones from heaven’s blows or fire’s consumption; those who yield to it in repentance are crushed by wisdom’s word like grain, made into sweet bread. It utterly devours the depraved and aged, led astray by deceit’s cravings. It also exposes those turning from evil to divine knowledge, stripping their sinful acts nerve by nerve, so they may shed the old self and don the new God made man—demon proof, Lord cleansed, sin free—becoming impervious as young eagles or, like scorched ashes, proof against eagles’ talons; my words are encompassed, etc. Who collected the winds in his lap? Faith, the quick wind mind, drew them from east, west, north, and sea through divine knowledge, granting spiritual vision to hoard in virtues, since God’s knowledge is his lap, holding and ruling the godly as gold in a bosom. He who gathered east, west, north, sea—all earthly nations—and compressed them by virtues in faith toward him, Christ God,
pass_b_english:
That they may not neglect the instruction, for many are being led away by wickedness into death; and those who are being killed in innocence unto death, you shall not spare to buy with your own blood; but if you give money or a beneficial word when asked, and if you say, 'I do not know this person,' you will be convicted of lying, and you will be guilty of two things—falsehood and murder; for the One who fashions breath also knows all things that He gives to each according to their nature: good to the good, and evil to the evil. For it is evident that reward is not according to quantity; for the sufferings of the present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory that is to be revealed. But if anyone wishes to take hold according to quantity, let them suppose the recompense in proportion to each one's power, as also the gifts of the Spirit are given according to the proportion of faith. He who eats honey is the one who is benefited by the divine Scriptures; but the one who casts out the words from the things from which holy prophets and apostles have taken them, in doing and teaching, chews wax; and while eating honey is for the one who desires all things, eating wax is for the pure alone; or let honey be called the allegory, and wax, the literal exposition and investigation, in order to possess the hidden and deeper mind; for there is honey in the wax; and let the throat be the nourishing power of the soul, by which foods are conveyed into the belly; if therefore you accomplish these things—both those according to thought and those according to history—they will be to you a sensation of the wisdom itself, these wise doctrines; for if you find the spiritual mind of the Scripture, your end will be good, as it is said: 'Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His saints'; do not abandon the hope for the future; do not prefer the devil to the righteousness of God, which the just possess; and do not let yourself be fed by deadly foolish reasonings, which is the belly; do not betray God for the sake of pleasure; for this one is the pasture of the righteous.

And he will not leave you. God indeed turns away his wrath from the one who has fallen, having shown mercy to him; but he is angry with the one who rejoices over the downfall of his enemy. For everyone who exults over a soul perishing is like the devil, who does not desire that all people be saved and come to the knowledge of the truth. And indeed the Lord has commanded in the Gospels that we should pray for our enemies, that is, for all people. But the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God, is not fleshly, that is, not perceptible to the senses. Now whoever is delivered to it while stumbling, their bones shall be broken by blows from above; and their bones shall be consumed by burning fire. Or whoever is delivered to it for repentance, shall be broken by the word of his wisdom like grain, so that he may become sweet bread. –The sword of God destroys those who are corrupted and worn away by the lusts of deceit, utterly consuming them. Or those who come from wickedness to the knowledge of God, it strips bare by the nerves from their evil deeds, so that, having put off the old man, they may clothe themselves with the new man created according to God, who is also impervious to demons, having been cleansed by the Lord, and abstaining from every wickedness. For he adds that they may become impervious like young eagles; or because those who have been burned and reduced to ashes ultimately become impervious to the eagles. For indeed, my words have been surrounded, and so on. –Who gathered the winds in his bosom? The swift mind of the wind has gathered faith from the east and west, north and sea, in the knowledge of God, and has given them spiritual contemplation to store up in the virtues. For the knowledge of God is the bosom of God, in which he embraces and prevails over all the godly, just as one might embrace gold in one’s bosom. –He who gathered from the east and west, north and sea, all the earthly nations, and condensed them by the virtues in the faith directed toward him, Christ God,
